description: This file defines the ShareViewController class for an iOS app extension. It handles sharing content such as URLs, text, and images, extracting and sanitizing shared data, constructing message drafts, and sending them to an external 'OpenClaw' gateway via network requests. The class manages UI components, user interactions, and network communication with detailed error handling.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller managing sharing extensions, extracting shared content, providing a UI for message editing, and transmitting data to an external gateway.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initial setup of the view, setting size and UI.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Triggers draft preparation when the view appears.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the user interface components like text view and buttons.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared content, constructs draft message, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Handles send button tap, initiates message sending process.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Handles cancel button tap, dismisses extension.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Validates and sends the current draft message and attachments.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously sends message and attachments to external gateway via network request.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines if a retry with a legacy client ID is needed based on the error.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages to the user.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Creates a message string from shared content payload.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Sanitizes a fragment of shared text to exclude common unwanted phrases.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Extracts URL, text, title, and images from the shared items.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads and encodes an image attachment from a shared provider.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Selects the best image type identifier for an image provider.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Compresses an image to JPEG format under a size limit.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads a URL from a shared item provider.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text or URL string from a shared item provider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Loads a URL value from a provider for a specific type identifier.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Loads a text string from a provider for a specific type identifier.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Loads binary data from a provider for a specific type identifier.
